paragraphs: Reassurance Solutions sells ReassureHub, a cloud-based correctional health monitoring platform that aggregates data from contactless vital sign sensors and wearable devices into a single real-time dashboard. The contactless ReassureSense (XK300) sensor monitors heart rate, respiratory rate, motion, and presence without a wearable or physical contact. The ReassureBand adds a wearable option for individuals who may move throughout the facility, and its data streams into the same dashboard. ReassureAID is an overdose response kit integrated with ReassureHub for teams responding to abnormal vital-sign readings.

Reassurance Solutions says the platform is deployed in county jails, state correctional facilities, and regional detention centers across the United States. The site states deployment in over 200 correctional facilities across the United States. The platform is described as giving jail administrators and medical staff continuous visibility into inmate health. It is also described as built for the way correctional facilities actually operate and designed to be used by officers, not just medical staff.

Listed features include cell-level and block-level monitoring views and automated incident logs with timestamped response records. The platform is presented as integration-ready for jail management systems, with HIPAA-compliant data storage and role-based access controls. Pricing is presented on the site as inmate vital sign tracking beginning at just $1 a day.

quote.text: One platform. Multiple monitoring technologies. Built for the correctional environment.
